chapters.title: Why Sleep Labs Threw Out Night One (1966)
The Right-Ear Oddball Beep Wake Test
How to Disarm the Sentinel on Night One

shorts_extract.hook: Why you wake at every tiny sound on Night 1 in a hotel bed even when exhausted.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Tamaki & Sasaki (2016) scanning 35 brains across Night 1 vs Night 2 with oddball earphone beeps.
shorts_extract.twist: Your sleep isn't broken — your left hemisphere stays in shallow dolphin-like night-watch mode until Night 2.
